استنزفا (form X)
# اِسْتَنْزَفَا (istanzafā) /is.tan.za.faː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَنْزَفَ (istanzafa)
# اُسْتُنْزِفَا (ustunzifā) /us.tun.zi.faː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِسْتَنْزَفَ (istanzafa)
# اِسْتَنْزِفَا (istanzifā) /is.tan.zi.faː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَنْزَفَ (istanzafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
